description: This file contains the implementation of a test grain class and related state classes for Orleans-based testing of log consistency providers, including state management, event application, and grain interface methods.

classes.name: MyGrainState
classes.description: Represents the state of the grain, including fields A, B, and a Reservations dictionary, with methods to apply updates.

classes.name: UpdateA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update to field A.

classes.name: UpdateB
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update to field B.

classes.name: IncrementA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an increment operation on A.

classes.name: AddReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing adding a reservation.

classes.name: RemoveReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing removing a reservation.

classes.name: LogTestGrain
classes.description: Abstract grain class used for testing log consistency providers, with methods for updating and retrieving state.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation behavior, does not wait for initial load.

methods.name: SetAGlobal
methods.description: Sets the value of A globally and confirms events.

methods.name: SetAConditional
methods.description: Sets the value of A conditionally based on version.

methods.name: SetALocal
methods.description: Sets the value of A locally.

methods.name: SetBGlobal
methods.description: Sets the value of B globally and confirms events.

methods.name: SetBLocal
methods.description: Sets the value of B locally.

methods.name: IncrementAGlobal
methods.description: Increments A globally and confirms events.

methods.name: IncrementALocal
methods.description: Increments A locally.

methods.name: GetAGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the global value of A.

methods.name: GetALocal
methods.description: Retrieves the local tentative value of A.

methods.name: GetBothGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B globally.

methods.name: GetBothLocal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B locally.

methods.name: AddReservationLocal
methods.description: Adds a reservation locally.

methods.name: RemoveReservationLocal
methods.description: Removes a reservation locally.

methods.name: GetReservationsGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves all reservations globally.

methods.name: SynchronizeGlobalState
methods.description: Synchronizes the global state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the current state and version.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the state with a list of updates if the version matches.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: GetEventLog
methods.description: Retrieves the event log.
